prompt: Product design sheet for a futuristic neon racing game: ten clearly different wheel designs (rim + tyre), each shown from its outer face, slightly three-quarter, arranged in a neat 5 by 2 grid on a plain dark grey background, even studio light, no car, no text, no labels.
